card.name: Punctuation ending drug lists
card.fires_on: Commas, closing parentheses and 'and' right after a drug name in a list of drugs, just before the sentence continues. Also the space before a number in a concentration.

modes.label: After listed drug names
modes.description: A comma or closing bracket right after the last drug in an 'including ...' list, before the main clause resumes.
modes.example: with ACE inhibitors, including enalapril<<,>> may result in deterioration of renal function,

modes.label: Treatment lists
modes.description: Comma or 'and' inside a list of treatments given for allergic reactions.
modes.example: All patients should be pretreated with corticosteroids, diphenhydramine,<< and>> H 2 antagonists

modes.label: Space before concentration
modes.description: The space before a number in a dilution or concentration statement.
modes.example: to a final concentration of<< >>1 mg/mL: Aseptically
